chores_completion.name: chores_completion
chores_completion.value: ("chores"."is_completed" AND "chores"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "chores"."completed_by_id" IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT "chores"."is_completed" AND "chores"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "chores"."completed_by_id" IS NULL)

expense_allocation_participants_value.name: expense_allocation_participants_value
expense_allocation_participants_value.value:
COALESCE(CASE "expense_allocation_participants"."allocation_method"
        WHEN 'equal' THEN "expense_allocation_participants"."value" IS NULL
        WHEN 'percentage' THEN "expense_allocation_participants"."value" BETWEEN 1 AND 10000
        WHEN 'shares' THEN "expense_allocation_participants"."value" > 0
        WHEN 'exact' THEN "expense_allocation_participants"."value" >= 0
        WHEN 'adjustment' THEN "expense_allocation_participants"."value" IS NOT NULL
      END, false)
